summary: PAPER-KOYMANS-MILOVIC-21 extracts Koymans–Milovic, Joint distribution of spins (Duke Math. J. 170 (2021), read as arXiv v1). It has 28 items (2 library, 5 planned, 21 missing), 5 routes and 8 source issues. Routes 1–4 survive the later narrowings of ST.2, ST.3 and CA.1. They are consistent with the Bhargava–Gross–Wang and Koymans–Pagano extractions, and the prerequisites cover every source used in a proof. Two findings, one medium and one low. (1, medium) Route 5 sends Conjecture C_n and Corollary 2.2 to AnalyticNumberTheory:AN.6 as 'the conjecture register'. The accepted RS-07 had dropped AN.6 the day before the extraction, and the AN packet closes it with no nodes. So the two items have no live owner, and none of RS-07's successor layers takes conjectural character-sum bounds. They belong with their only consumers, the spin sieve of route 1 at SV.5, stated as explicit hypotheses. (2, low) There is no sourceVersions list.
checked: Independence: the extraction is by Claude Code cc-fb70e5 (issue #1318) and its review by Claude Code cc-442dc5. This worker (Claude Code, cc-c2c06b) did neither.

Downloaded arXiv 1809.09597v1 on 2026-09-30; its SHA-256 matches d56a738a…f433. Searched the text for Burgess and for unconditional cases. Every theorem is stated under Conjecture C_{|S|n} or C_{tn}, and the paper never invokes Burgess, so no unconditional input is missing.

Read all five routes and their reasons, and the statuses of all 28 items, in the repository at d4afbc98. All 11 cited stage ids exist in the assembled atlas (2840 stages, 8007 edges). Restructurings: AN.6 was dropped by RS-07 (finding 1). ST.2 and ST.3 were narrowed by RS-07; route 2's geometric sieve fits ST.2's 'uniform tail estimates', and the governing-field and 16-rank items fit ST.3's 'class-group asymptotics'. CA.1 was narrowed by RS-03 and still keeps 'power-residue/Hilbert-symbol extensions, including the place 2, infinite places', which covers route 3. GN.4 and SV.5 are unchanged.

Consistency with neighbouring extractions. PAPER-BHARGAVA-GROSS-WANG-17 routes its geometric-sieve tail estimate to ST.2, as route 2 does. PAPER-KOYMANS-PAGANO's Smith-method Part II brief imports 'ST.3 (class-group distributions, governing fields, 2^k-ranks)' 'through PAPER-KOYMANS-MILOVIC-21', which matches route 2. Its Rédei and 'Pellian spin symbol' items are algebraic identities in that Part II, not the analytic spin theorems of route 1. Searched every other extraction for spins, governing fields, 8- and 16-ranks, FIMR, bilinear sieves and Widmer: no duplicate owner.

Statuses: Tau Ceti f790474 has only the definitional API NumberField.Set.HasNaturalDensity (ArithmeticDirichletSeries/NaturalDensity.lean:61), not Chebotarev's natural-density theorem, so item 7's planned status (Chebotarev Layer 14) is right. The two library items were verified by the review. No stage mentions Burgess or short character sums.
Prerequisites: the ten listed cover every reference used in a proof. The two paper references not listed, Cohn–Lagarias [4] and Smith [10], are cited only in the introduction.
Source issues: did not re-verify E1–E8 against the text; the review confirmed them at their locators, and all affect nothing.

findings.claim: Route 5 sends Conjecture C_n (FIMR's short real character sum conjecture) and its arithmetic-progression form, Corollary 2.2, to AnalyticNumberTheory:AN.6 as 'the statement register for conjectural analytic inputs'. The accepted RS-07 had already dropped AN.6: 'This is an export/register stage, not a separate mathematical construction.' RS-07 was accepted on 2026-09-21, before this extraction (2026-09-22) and its review (2026-09-23), and the review accepted route 5 unchanged. The AN packet closes AN.6 with no nodes, so the two items have no live owner. RS-07 redistributed AN.6's contents by type: zero-free regions to AN.2, RH/GRH and density statements to AN.3, conditional continuation statements to AN.4, distribution hypotheses to SV.3 and prime tuples to SV.4. A conjectural bound for short character sums is none of these. AN.4's narrowed text keeps only 'conditional general-continuation statements from AN.6'. The only consumers of C_n in the atlas are this paper's type I/type II spin sieve and Theorems 1–2, which route 1 already sends to SieveMethodsAndPrimePatterns:SV.5. SV.5 'owns advanced sieves as separate developments with their own bilinear … inputs'. No stage in the atlas mentions Burgess or short character sums.
